frontMatter.title: Monday Club Night: Badminton under the Lights at Claremont Stadium
frontMatter.summary: Two matches under the lights (Grade 3 Ladies: Navan ‘A’ vs Swords, Grade 4 Mens: Navan vs Ardee ‘C’), juvenile club times, and two courts available from 9pm for members.

prev.title: Big Wins, Finals Secured & A Huge Week Ahead
prev.summary: Grade 2 Ladies 'A' and Grade 2 Mens recorded 4–0 wins to secure League Final and Semi-Final spots, while Grade 6 Mens reached the Cup Final. A huge week follows with the final league games, Doubles Quarter-Finals, and Cup Semi-Finals. No club night this Wednesday due to MBA Quarter-Finals in Claremont Stadium.
